grammar.q: The researchers collected a large amount of [ ____ ] from students in five different cities.
The museum received a lot of [ ____ ] from an old palace last year.
Not much [ ____ ] was given to the new students about choosing their elective classes and extracurricular activities.
Two of the five books on the desk are mine, and [ ____ ] belong to my sister.
The gymnastics team trained [ ____ ] every morning to prepare for the national competition in May.
The way the students solved the difficult problem seemed quite [ ____ ] to the judges.
The quality of this year’s apples is much better than [ ____ ] of last year’s harvest, which was damaged by an unusually early frost.
The children were left to look after [ ____ ] while their parents were at work.
We had [ ____ ] chances to practice speaking English during the long winter vacation.
The museum is [ ____ ] to the subway station, so we can walk there in ten minutes.
Please make [ ____ ] comfortable while I prepare some tea and snacks for all of us.
The colors of this painting are much brighter than [ ____ ] of the copy in the hallway.
The judges found the young pianist’s performance in the final round [ ____ ] and gave her first prize.
The students listened [ ____ ] as the scientist explained how black holes are formed.
The museum gives visitors a lot of helpful [ ____ ] about the paintings and ceramics in each room.
The detective found enough [ ____ ] to prove that the hotel’s gardener had stolen the jewels during the wedding reception.
Surprisingly, [ ____ ] of the volunteers stayed after the event to help clean the park.
We have very [ ____ ] money left this month, so we will cook at home.
After the long hike through the canyon, the tired campers found [ ____ ] too exhausted to cook dinner by the fire.
The twins taught [ ____ ] to play the guitar by watching free online videos with English subtitles every night.
The coach asked the players to trust [ ____ ] and follow the new training plan, which included a short sprint around the field every morning.
Each of the classrooms in the new building has [ ____ ] own air conditioner.
The temperature in the desert at night is much lower than [ ____ ] during the day.
The rules of soccer are easier to learn than [ ____ ] of baseball for many young children.
Of the two candidates for class president, one is my cousin, and [ ____ ] is my neighbor.
Some people enjoy spending their weekends outdoors, while [ ____ ] prefer to rest quietly at home or run errands in the neighborhood.
My old laptop broke last week, so I bought a new [ ____ ] with the money from my part-time job.
The fresh bread that the bakery sells every morning smells [ ____ ] when you walk past the shop.
The thick fog over the highway this morning made driving very [ ____ ] for everyone, especially the drivers of large cargo trucks heading to the port.
Before signing the contract, the manager read every page of the document [ ____ ] .
The price of plane tickets to Jeju Island has risen [ ____ ] since the summer vacation began.
The volunteers worked [ ____ ] all weekend to rebuild the houses damaged by the flood.
The new student was so shy that he [ ____ ] spoke to anyone during his first week.
My grandmother has been feeling much better [ ____ ] , so she has started walking again.
The marathon runner was [ ____ ] exhausted when she finally crossed the finish line in first place.
The small boat was not [ ____ ] to carry all ten passengers across the river.
Is there [ ____ ] to watch on TV tonight before we go to bed?
It was [ ____ ] an exciting game that the fans kept cheering long after it had ended.
The instructions for the new washing machine were [ ____ ] confusing that we had to call a plumber to install it.
The camping equipment that we borrowed from our neighbors [ ____ ] returned in perfect condition.

arrange.ko: 그 실험의 결과는 작년의 결과보다 더 정확했다.
arrange.bogi: than those of last year. / the results of the experiment / were more accurate
arrange.ans: The results of the experiment were more accurate than those of last year.

arrange.ko: 우리 반 학생들 중 일부는 버스로 학교에 오고, 나머지 학생들은 걸어온다.
arrange.bogi: the others walk. / some of the students in our class / and / come to school by bus,
arrange.ans: Some of the students in our class come to school by bus, and the others walk.

arrange.ko: 그 유명한 가수에 관한 소식은 너무 놀라워서 처음에는 우리 반 아무도 그것을 믿을 수 없었다.
arrange.bogi: nobody in our class could believe it at first. / so surprising / the news about the famous singer was / that
arrange.ans: The news about the famous singer was so surprising that nobody in our class could believe it at first.

arrange.ko: 그 젊은 가수는 자신의 첫 앨범이 전 세계의 음악 팬들에게 들리기를 원했다.
arrange.bogi: to be heard by music fans all around the world. / the young singer / her first album / wanted
arrange.ans: The young singer wanted her first album to be heard by music fans all around the world.

arrange.ko: 그 맛이 좋든 싫든 너는 매 식사 후에 이 약을 먹어야 한다.
arrange.bogi: its taste or not. / you have to take this medicine / after every meal whether you like
arrange.ans: You have to take this medicine after every meal whether you like its taste or not.

arrange.ko: 중요한 것은 네가 실수를 하는지가 아니라 그 실수에서 배우는지이다.
arrange.bogi: but whether you learn from them. / what matters is / not whether you make mistakes
arrange.ans: What matters is not whether you make mistakes but whether you learn from them.

arrange.ko: 그 소설의 마지막 장면은 너무 슬퍼서 많은 독자들이 책을 덮은 뒤에도 울었다.
arrange.bogi: that many readers cried even after they closed the book. / so sad / the last scene of the novel was
arrange.ans: The last scene of the novel was so sad that many readers cried even after they closed the book.

arrange.ko: 이러한 선택들은 사용자의 기기와 콘텐츠를 전달하는 서버 둘 다에서 더 많은 에너지를 소비한다.
arrange.bogi: consume more energy / these choices / on both the user’s device / and the servers delivering the content.
arrange.ans: These choices consume more energy on both the user’s device and the servers delivering the content.

arrange.ko: 자동 재생 영상은 우리가 그것들을 전혀 보고 있지 않을 때에도 우리 기기에서 계속 재생된다.
arrange.bogi: we are not watching them at all. / autoplaying videos / keep running on our devices even when
arrange.ans: Autoplaying videos keep running on our devices even when we are not watching them at all.

arrange.ko: 인도에서 집으로 돌아오는 길에, 상인은 Tuti에게 그 슬픈 소식을 어떻게 전할지 계속 생각했다.
arrange.bogi: how he could tell Tuti the sad news. / on his way home from India, / the merchant kept thinking about
arrange.ans: On his way home from India, the merchant kept thinking about how he could tell Tuti the sad news.

arrange.ko: 그는 그 메시지를 전해 주겠다고 약속하고 나서 여행을 떠났다.
arrange.bogi: to go on his trip. / he promised / and then left / to deliver the message
arrange.ans: He promised to deliver the message and then left to go on his trip.

translate.en: TV presenters and journalists might not have been able to use slang, but content creators can.
translate.ko: TV 진행자와 기자들은 슬랭을 사용할 수 없었을지도 모르지만, 콘텐츠 제작자들은 사용할 수 있다. / NEW 내가 집을 나설 때 남동생이 아직 자고 있었으니, 그는 오늘 아침 알람을 듣지 못했을지도 모른다.

translate.en: The ethical line is not whether nudging exists, but whether it is transparent, reversible, and aligned with the user’s interests.
translate.ko: 윤리적 기준은 행동 유도가 존재하느냐가 아니라, 그것이 투명하고 되돌릴 수 있으며 사용자의 이익과 일치하느냐이다. / NEW 진짜 문제는 학생들이 스마트폰을 사용하느냐가 아니라 그것을 매일 현명하게 사용하느냐이다.

translate.en: If you wanted your voice to be heard by the public, you had to work within their limits, conforming to the strict expectations of either print or broadcast media.
translate.ko: 만약 당신이 당신의 목소리가 대중에게 들리기를 원했다면, 당신은 인쇄 혹은 방송 매체의 엄격한 기대에 순응하며, 그들의 제약 안에서 활동해야만 했다.

translate.en: The playing field is now level, and public access is democratized.
translate.ko: 이제 경기장은 평평해졌고(누구에게나 공평해졌고), 대중의 접근은 민주화되었다.

translate.en: We regularly use words like ‘function’ and ‘side-eye,’ and our influence both legitimizes these terms and gives them a large platform to spread quicker than they could have before.
translate.ko: 우리는 ‘function’과 ‘side-eye’ 같은 단어를 일상적으로 사용하며, 우리의 영향력은 이러한 용어를 합법화하고 그것들이 이전보다 더 빠르게 퍼질 수 있는 큰 플랫폼을 제공한다.

translate.en: This means that slang can more naturally go beyond the economic and social barriers that once limited its growth.
translate.ko: 이것은 슬랭이 한때 그 성장을 제한했던 경제적, 사회적 장벽을 더 자연스럽게 넘어설 수 있다는 것을 의미한다.

translate.en: The loose social networks that previously connected us geographically are simply stronger online, and memes are now transmitted at rapid pace.
translate.ko: 이전에는 지리적으로 우리를 연결했던 느슨한 사회적 네트워크가 온라인상에서는 단순히 더 강하며, 밈은 이제 빠른 속도로 전파된다.
